facts.text: Applicants must submit a portfolio of 12 to 20 pieces demonstrating technical skill, problem solving, and proficiency across chosen artistic media.

sources.title: Application Requirements - Cleveland Institute of Art
sources.quote: Your portfolio should include your best 12 to 20 pieces of work. The selections should highlight your technical skills, problem-solving skills, and how you use your chosen mediums.
